description: In config.rs, ConfigError is a plain enum but has no From<io::Error>, From<toml::de::Error>, or From<String> impls. All construction sites use explicit ConfigError::Io(...) or ConfigError::Parse(...) variant construction. Adding From impls would allow ? to propagate errors from file I/O and TOML parsing directly, eliminating several explicit .map_err() calls and making the config loading code more idiomatic. This is a Rust idiom issue (error-handling category).
title: smtp: ConfigError missing From<io::Error> and From<String> impls
